From the brand

  2. One of the best parts of owning and enjoying physical objects is that they can move us out of our busy, overworked minds and return us to the sensory pleasures of touching, seeing, and doing.

    We’re not the kind of brand that wants to go on about the “essence of design,” but if we had to sum up our thoughts on the subject we’d say that it’s all about balancing the limitless magic of an object with its tactile, real-world functionality.

  3. Our Best Sellers

  4. Eyewear Stand

    The minimal cast-metal pedestal for eyewear.

  5. Our Puzzles

  7. Daily Useful Items

  8. Who are we?

    Founded in 2015 by designer Hunter Craighill, we are a design and manufacturing brand rooted in curiosity, ingenuity, and satisfaction.

    The thought behind the process

    We know that the world already has too much “stuff” and that you don’t need yet another shiny object. That’s why we design our products to be as functional and timeless as they are beautiful and intriguing.

    Why do you need us?

    Whether you are looking to find a more seductive way to protect and store your glasses, a more beautiful home for your keys, or a sculptural pillow for your wallet, we’re here for you.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    I got this to be a strong business card holder. I ended up replacing my Ridge wallet with this instead. The rounded corners leave less of a silhouette in the pocket. I keep 8 cards in it with 2-3 bills folded and it doesn’t rattle at all. It’s heavier than I thought it would be, but I like that because it feels durable. The design makes me the of an old cigarette holder or a big rounded Zippo lighter. I am scared to scratch the brass when it’s new. I think with time the patina will add to the charm.

    My partner needed a new, simple card holder and was especially happy to see this design. When we first opened it up however, we almost threw it out because it was so difficult to open and close.

    This problem is fixable with wear and maybe a lubricant if you want to take it that far. We just wore the hinge down by opening and closing it enough that it's easy to do so now. My partner is happy with the ease of use and overall simplicity. It light weight, a nice color, and feels like it'll survive a high drop. Overall, I think it's great after you get past the initial difficulties.

      I wanted to fall in love with this card holder but it was disappointing overall, especially given its higher price-point. Upon arrival I was initially impressed. The item arrived well packaged w/ beautiful recyclable cork inserts and branding. At first, the top of the card case was tight, exceptionally tight, however only after a few uses, the top stopped securing at all. I returned the initial one and received a second one. While the second case has a much tighter fitting top, it's also loosening and I can only imagine that in time, this case top won't stay shut as well. Given its sleek design and heavyweight, it can easily fall out of larger pockets, scratch easily and fall open, releasing all of your business cards about. I really love the design, but will probably not be using this outside of my office.

      I wanted to fall in love with this card holder but it was disappointing overall, especially given its higher price-point. Upon arrival I was initially impressed. The item arrived well packaged w/ beautiful recyclable cork inserts and branding. At first, the top of the card case was tight, exceptionally tight, however only after a few uses, the top stopped securing at all. I returned the initial one and received a second one. While the second case has a much tighter fitting top, it's also loosening and I can only imagine that in time, this case top won't stay shut as well. Given its sleek design and heavyweight, it can easily fall out of larger pockets, scratch easily and fall open, releasing all of your business cards about. I really love the design, but will probably not be using this outside of my office.
